G_N_definition_fixed_before_compute: G_N[j,k] = 2 Re( s_j' conj(s_k) + s_k' conj(s_j) ) on the summands s_n = I_n(p,th)+I_n(-p,-th), n<=N, s_n' = d/dp at fixed th,N; N x N real symmetric; h_N = 1^T G_N 1. Spectrum computed exactly through the rank-4 factorisation G_N = W C W^T, W=[Re u, Im u, Re v, Im v], C = 2*antidiag-pair matrix of signature (2,2); full mp.eigsy cross-check on the first 3 points of each run.
pre_run_structural_note: By Sylvester's law of inertia G_N has exactly 2 negative and 2 positive eigenvalues and N-4 exact zeros wherever the four columns of W are linearly independent, independently of the sign of h_N. Hence the 'square in the ray basis' is expected invisible at every point for both zeta and DH; the numbers will confirm or refute this.
